notes.title: 0430 Open Beta Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We've fixed some bugs and added six new items in this version.

If you want to help us test, you can right-click on the game name > Properties > Betas, select "open beta," and then enter the password "openbetabeta" to start testing. Please remember to back up your save files before starting the game. The path is: C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\glassheart\Vigil\one.io

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players couldn't activate the haircut conversation when using Japanese.
[*] Removed the sound when starting a dialogue.
[*] Fixed the issues where damage and heal numbers wouldn't disappear or would display incorrectly.
[*] Optimized the description texts for equipment set effects; some effects are now directly displayed in the status UI.
[*] Corrected some punctuation errors in the English texts.
[*] Enhanced the Frost Suit.
[*] Buffed the Phantom Daggers and the Frost Suit.
[*] Spending one skill point at the Skill Master now increases Cooldown Reduction by 2%.

[b]Locations for the new items:[/b]
[spoiler]
Azure Star Ring: Hidden mission in Shadow Disaster
Entwined Ring: Hidden mission in Shadow Disaster
Decree of Light: Hidden mission in Shadow Disaster
Mutated Finger: Dropped by the Doctor in his second transformation phase
Bound Demon Heart: Chance drop by the mid-boss in the Wasted Town
Emerald Luminous Butterfly: Obtained through conversation at the Mill after completing August's mission[/spoiler]

Have a great day.

notes.title: 0409 Game Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

After a few days of testing, our Open Beta is now fully updated and aligned with the official release.

Here's what's new in this update:

[olist]
[*] Damage numbers can now display up to six digits.
[*] Optimized the translation for Spanish. Thx to Héctor López again!
[*] Removed the background music from Peak of Weep.
[*] Optimized the damage calculation.
[*] Fixed the incorrectly calculated attribute damage for thrown/arcane items. 
[*] Damage from Molotovs and Dynamite will now be affected by fire resistance.
[*] The training dummy in the weapon shop now has zero defense and magic resistance.
[*] Corrected the damage range for The Flower of Doth.
[*] Increased the magic move speed of Weird Pot.
[*] nerf the attack power of the Staff of the Holy Six.
[*] Fixed a bug where the item wheel would jump visually when rotated.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented rapid potion use while standing and equipped with a bow.
[*] Fixed a bug where items could not be used when dropping off platforms.
[*] Fixed a bug where The Flower of Doth would fly too far at high arcane stat.
[*] Adjusted the size of the save screen capture for better visibility.
[*] Added million-digit damage display.
[*] Balanced the arcane items.
[*] Increased the cap for throwing and arcane points to 1499.
[*] While increasing abilities at the Skill Master, keep pressing the button to speed up the allocation of skill points.
[*] The Sunrise Ring's arcane stat increases with each cycle, allowing players to track the current game cycle.
[*] Daylight's damage increases with each cycle.
[*] The Mysterious Trader now offers three new items after completing her quest:
[/olist][list]
[*] VIP Ring: Provides discounts on store purchases.
[*] Eye of the Sorcerer Ring: Restores MP when dealing damage to enemies.
[*] Flawless Jade Ring: Provides a Rejuvenation effect. It shatters after activation.
[/list]


If you have any suggestions, feel free to post them here or share in the Steam Discussions.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: 8/15 Update - Support multi controllers and debug mode
notes.content:
We notice there’s a serious bug that caused the save unreadable. 

We’ve fixed this bug in the patch. But for the better support of controllers, we don’t use Steam input anymore. If you’re playing with a controller, please disable Steam input in properties>controller.

If your save file is broken, please send an email to glassheart.tw@gmail.com
Describe items, levels, and progress. We will do our best to help get it back.

Sorry for the inconvenience. We will make a formal announcement soon.

8/15 - Update multi-controller support and debug function

Press Ctrl + F5 will show your controller info on the screen. If the screen doesn't show anything, you might need to check the connection, reinstall the controller driver, or whether your controller signal is intercepted by Steam.

If your controller buttons are messed up on the game and you're using a DS4 or Switch pro controller, please check the System > controller menu, make sure controller icons show correctly. If it shows Xbox icons, you can restart the game or close controller emulator software like DS4windows or X360ce.

8/22 - Fixed the DS4 controller Bluetooth bug

8/24 - Support Steam input

Switch pro controller connects with USB, needs to turn on the Steam input.

If you have any further controller problems, please leave us a message and take a screenshot. It can help us to debug.

Thank you again for helping.

tags.bug: We’ve fixed this bug in the patch.
- Fixed the DS4 controller Bluetooth bug

notes.title: Blackscreen & Turkish Language Bug Fix
notes.content:
[h1]To our Turkish followers, and anyone else who has a black screen problem while opening the game: [/h1]

  

Hello from Glassheart Studio and Another Indie. 

  
We noticed while reading user reviews that some players were having trouble running Vigil: The Longest Night on Steam. It took us quite some time to find the root cause of this problem, and fixing it took even longer. 

However, we are happy to report that the bug has now been fixed! 

We also saw that many of you were asking for Turkish language support, and believe me, we want that for you too!. That being said, we already have other development plans in the works, and we need to get these things done before being able to work on improved language support.  

Thank you all for your patience and we apologize for the inconvenience. 

   
If you experience a black screen while starting the game, please check whether MSI Afterburner or RivaTuner programs are running on your computer. These programs can cause problems that prevent Vigil: The Longest Night from working. 

 
Finally, we would like to thank Localsheep for helping us find the source of the problem and test it. 

  
Regards, 
Glassheart and Another Indie

tags.bug: However, we are happy to report that the bug has now been fixed!

notes.title: The Bounty of the Night Update🩸
notes.content:
[u][b]The Bounty of the Night[/b][/u] updates add a trove of new content and improve almost every aspect of the game. We’ve been listening closely to feedback and working with the community on Steam, Discord, Facebook, and Twitter to improve the player experience of Vigil: The Longest Night.
 
You can see the full patch notes below but we’ve done a full overhaul of the game’s English localization, improved the map, and generally tweaked, improved, and polished every aspect of Vigil: The Longest Night.

[u]We’ve also added  40+ weapons and armor and some new quest rewards too!
[/u]
We want to thank EVERYONE who left a review (positive or negative!) and everyone who reached out to us with kind words, feedback, or open criticism. This is Glass Heart’s first game and we are genuinely overjoyed by the outpouring of support from fans around the world. 
Before we enter the holiday season, we wanted to get this update out to you and make your holidays a little happier!

[list]
[*] Added: A Large Number of New items and Equipment
[*] Improved: Overhaul of English Language Localization
[*] Added: New weapon actions
[*] Improved: monster drop rate mechanics
[*] Map update: Fixed icon errors and issues with maps not revealing hidden areas once found
[*] Added a number before every portal's name
[/list]

[list]
[*] Modification: Support added for third party controllers (None Xbox, PS, and Switch controllers)
[*] Update: NPC dialogues (mostly Nordell and some of the traders)
[*] Update: Added names to map( Added names on rooms in the Abandoned Town and the Flooded Area)
[*] Update: Tutorial for saving and teleporting are separated now
[*] Improvement: The Miner rescue quest will now remind players and show the miner's corpse when failed.
[*] Fixed: The enchantment special effects of fire and curse now work as intended.
[*] Improved all Leila's actions:
[*] Decreased the movement distance of a normal attack.
[*] Removed the slow effect when landed from jumping.
[*] Improved the third attack of dual weapon's air combo.
[*] The combo's triggering time has been changed to 0.25 sec on the keyboard and 0.45 sec on controllers.
[*] Fixed: Loading, squatting down, or entering another scene when using the bow and holding the other 3 weapons will cause immediate death.
[*] Fixed: Many fall through issues scatters around throughout the game
[*] Fixed: Autosave in the Owl Statue will cause some monsters to repeatedly play the death animation
[*] Fixed: Now the NPC Alice's name is all changed to Iris.
[*] Fixed: The Hand of Glory bug
[*] Fixed: Now Hilda won't disappear in the Mill after the apocalypse
[*] Fixed: Now the Lower Underground Hall's portal name displays correctly.
[*] Fixed: Percival's buff is now effective with all other enchantment effects.
[/list]


We will see you again in the New Year!

Yours,

Glass Heart and Another Indie

notes.title: Beta Branch is now available
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone! 

First of all, Happy New Year! [/h2]

After weeks of hard work, we’ve completed the Bounty of the Night update! There’s such a huge amount of content added that we’ve decided to launch a Beta branch and request your help to test it! 

[u][b]To join the Beta, please back up your save file first! IF YOU DON’T BACK UP YOUR SAVE DATA YOU MAY LOSE PROGRESS AND CANNOT GO BACK TO THE CURRENT VERSION!  
[/b][/u]
Due to massive changes, the map of Maye will once again be shrouded in darkness with a lot of new secrets to discover. 

[u]To copy your save file please follow these instructions:[/u] 
[list]
[*] Please open the C:>User>xxx>AppData>LocalLow>glassheart>Vigil_Night  
[*] Then duplicate the one.IO file to the desktop. 
[/list]

[u]To Access the Beta please follow these instructions: [/u]
[list]
[*] Go to the Big Picture Mode> Library> Vigil> Manage game> Select Beta 
[*] Enter the passcode: openbetabeta 
[*] Select the openbeta and start the game.
[/list] 

 

[u]Update Notes [/u]

1. Improved the map UI. Now the map shows discovered hidden areas and as well as interior areas.  

2. 50+ new equipment and items. No more useless items in hidden chests! 

3. Balance the game. Buffed axes and swords. Buffed stronger enemies and bosses. 

 

If you encountered any bugs, please let us know. You can reply here or email us: glassheart.tw@gmail.com

notes.title: Patch Two: Controller Update and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Vigilants,[/h1]

[b][u]We are happy to announce that the next update for Vigil: The Longest Night is live now[/u][/b]. This patch continues to stamp out pesky bugs and address some of your biggest concerns! The Glass Heart and Another Indie teams are continuing to go through your feedback and improve Vigil: The Longest Night! If you have feedback, questions, queries, or complaints, you can always reach us at in the Steam Forums or in our Discord!

This update is small in terms of content but big in terms of bug fixes and polish and addresses the controller issues that have plagued us since launch! We will have more news about upcoming content over the next few weeks and months. But rest assured, Leila’s journey isn’t over.
If any players have issues with gamepads, please check our Steam Forum for fixes. People who changed their Steam settings previously may need to take a few extra steps! We’ve got you covered 😊

You can check out the patch notes bellow but beware, there are [u][b]SPOILERS [/b][/u]within:


[h3]Major Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lower lowered enemy attributes (HP, EXP, Attack, etc.) in NG+ and further rounds of NG+.
[*] This caters to the needs of hardcore players and story/quest lovers! A round 20 enemy's power is roughly equal to previous version's power at round 6. We welcome hardest-core players to challenge Vigil for 100 rounds!
[*] Now Character's Arcane attribute will increase more Arcane spell damage and mana.
[*] Increased the Flaming Magpie's basic damage.
[*] Vigil: The Longest Night now uses Steam Input to read gamepad inputs. 
[*]For older players - you need to revert to your [i]Global Steam Input Settings[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34379227/3d9b0a8838b6212fa627276bcc9a48d0c3f1ea41.png[/img]

[h3]Map[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed - Bug that allowed player to see the closed path using Glowing Orb.
[*] Fixed - Bug that when in 5:4 resolution screen, the player will be blocked by an air wall after entering the Brood Mother area.
[*] Added - A hint of light to the entrance of the cave to reveal a hidden path.
[*] Optimized- Map fog clearance improved
[*] Deleted - Incorrect treasure chest at the Peak of Weep.
[*] Fixed- A bug that allowed player to pass through walls in the Cemetery.
[*] Adjusted - BGM in the Forest areas.
[*] Optimized - Lowered the brightness in certain scene
[*] Fixed - A bug that the map won't show player's location when checked inside the Giantwood
[*] Optimized- Moved the teleporter's location to the Shadow Disaster to the entrance 
[*] Optimized - Lowered the sound effects of the ice cube attack in The Frozen Realm
[*] Adjusted - Location of the Elevator Lever and enemies in the Secret Trail.
[*] Fixed - Clear the last teleport place before starting new game +. You can't use Owl's Feather before interacting with another Owl Statue
[*] Fixed - An issue that after completing the Mine Pit, sliding backward on the ramp causes the player to fall out of the scene
[/list]

[h3]Monsters[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized- Removed the Craving Terror's jump-oppressing action
[*] Optimized - Removed the Brood Mother's falling rock attack after her ground attack.
[*] Fixed - The bug that allowed the players to get behind the Brood Mother.
[*] Optimized - Kelpie's overall actions.
[*] Reduced the delay between Lord of the Misty Lake Boss intro and combat.
[*] Fixed the damage triggering issue of Erupting Flesh Cluster's fire attack. Can no longer be burned once the flame attack is finished.
[*] Optimized - Scholar of the Sacred Wood's special effects.
[*] Optimized - Extended the AI search distance of certain bosses.
[*] Tara's jump height has been increased.
[*] Optimized - Strengthened the Mutated Flesh enemies in Maye Sewer.
[*] Added - A few Explosive Old Man enemies to the mine
[*] Adjustment - Earth Spider can be attacked while hiding
[*] Adjustment - Raised the height of the event frame in the Lord of the Misty Lake's boss fight so players can't move behind it anymore.
[*] Fixed - Poison damage no longer stuns enemies for long periods but does interrupt their actions.
[*] Adjustment - Tweaked the animation of the Hammer Miner. It's easier to interrupt his movements now.
[/list]

[h3]Main Character[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized - Two-handed weapon's charging action, trigger timing and animation.
[*] Optimized - Minor modification to the trigger timing of "Comet Strike" skill.
[*] Fixed - Bug where the player couldn't stun an enemy after learning "Foresight" skill
[*] Optimized - All sword's special effect and sound effect.
[*] Fixed - bug that after exhaustion the gasping animation failed to trigger.
[*] Fixed - The issue where air-dash cannot be used immediately after falling while running.
[/list]

[h3]Equipment[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed- A bug that uses Arcane items twice while airborne
[*] Adjustment - Fishbone Bow's weapon action now has an area of effect
[*] Added - Curved Daggers now have a unique weapon action - Cross Slash
[*] Optimization - Increase the attack range of the Golden Hammer. 
[*] Optimization - The appearance and pictures of weapons and armor.
[*] Optimization - Increased the Spiked Reaper's weapon action damage.
[*] Optimization - Lowered the stamina cost of the following weapons:
[*] Saw Blade
[*] Excellent Saw Blade
[*] Blood-Stained Shovel
[*] Sacrificial Sword
[*] Obsidian Daggers
[*] Optimization - Strengthened the below weapons:
[*] Wakizashi
[*] Raven's Halberd
[*] Thorn Axe
[*] Fixed - Bug where the Stray Ring didn't actually increase experience gained
[*] Fixed - Bug where the Wrath of the Holy Six item will ignore the direction thrown and destroy one-way destroyable obstacles
[*] Modified - The Blacksmith sells all Vigilant gear at the start of the game.
[*] Fixed - Enchantment effects of Blood Shards (HP%) and Amber Sparks (Backstab)
[*] Fixed - A bug that using the Breath of the Ancient Guard will override the last Arcane Item used.
[/list]

[h3]Attributes and Statuses[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimization - Adjusted the calculation of Lightning Elemental damage, won't trigger error due to low Lightning Resistance.
[*] Adjusted the calculation of Poison Elemental damage, now all poison effects last longer and deal more damage (including those afflicted on monsters).
[*] Adjusted the calculation of Bleeding Affliction, now will interact normally with the monster's poise value. Damage value has been increased.
[*] Fixed - Bug that will occur after the value of "Reduce Debuff Duration" goes above 100
[/list]

[h3]Other [/h3]
[list]
[*] Modified - Side menu can be closed using Option (PS4) or Start (Xbox) buttons.
[*] Optimize - The item/equipment descriptions in both Chinese and English.
[*] Fixed - "Great Arcanist" and "Acrobat" achievements now trigger correctly. 
[*] Optimized the death sound effects of certain bosses.
[*] Adjustment/Added - Can now use Fledgling's Blood Soul in the Unknown Space, and added a teleporter at the beginning section so player can return to the Catacombs.
[*] Fixed - The bug that can't enter Leila's new home. (The one she bought in game)
[*] Fixed - Hilda will repeatedly re-appear
[*] Fixed - The bug that Tangerine can't receive the necklace.
[*] Now talking with the Foreman Edward after defeating the Mine Pit Boss will immediately update the "Rescue The Survivors" mission.
[/list]

[h3]Quest (Spoilers Alert!)[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now players can find 30 Mysterious Manuscripts in below locations:
[*] Empty Library *2
[*] Secret Cave *2
[*] Catacombs *2
[*] Professor's Home *2
[*] Library *2
[*] Shimmer Church *2
[*] Maye Hall - Workshop *2 
[*] Sunken Queen Anne's Revenge *2
[*] Bufonitte Lake *2
[*] Doctor's Home *2
[*] Bishop's Room *2
[*] Inside of the Giantwood *2
[*] Upper Underground Hall *2
[*] Middle Underground Hall *2
[*] Adjustments of "Placebo" Achievement
[*] Now Pierre won't take out Clay until Chapter 3
[*] Now the Fisher will be counted in this achievement. (But only count as 1 person)
[*] Now Hilda will wait in the Outskirt of Maye after received the Research Report.
[*] Now the Doctor will be in Asylum after Leila submit the Research Report.
[*] Adjustment: getting the Golden Slime's Plasmodium and not returning will now fail the Gold Rush quest in chapter 3.
[*] Fixed - Minor bugs when talking to Stein.
[*] Fixed - The bug where Tangerine can't receive the necklace and won’t give the Ruby Ring.
[*] Fixed - Talking to Shabbir and returning to Captain Carl will initiate a discussion about the Blood of the Sacredwood.
[*] Fixed - Passing the Blood of the Sacredwood to 3 pagans can complete the "Addict" quest.
[/list]

notes.title: Slaying Wretched Bugs and Building Terrible Worlds!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Vigilants! [/h1]
 
First, thank you for making the launch of [i]Vigil: The Longest Night[/i] such a wonderful experience. It’s been years of work by a small team and the response has been overwhelming. We’ve been reading through all your comments and feedback and are working on fixing, polishing, and updating.  
 
This first update is just the beginning for us, we are already working on a major polish of the English text, adding a whole bunch of requested features and a substantial content update! We cannot wait to share more with you all. 

[h3][u]Below are the Patch Notes [b]WHICH CONTAIN SPOILERS![/b] [/u]
[/h3]
 
[u][b]Major Fixes[/b][/u] 

[list]
[*] Can now open storage at save points 
[*] Fixed “Dephil's Will” achievement and final ending not showing issues. 
[*] Placebo Mission now unlocks achievements 
[*] Arcane Items are no longer broken when completing “The Draft in a Bottle” Quest
[/list] 

[u][b]English translation updated - more English polish incoming [/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Improved saving system that writes immediately to disk to prevent data loss. 
[*] All skill points can now be reset on Cat Isle 
[*] Classic Incense Burner can be found in a locked room in the Sewer on the Estuary 
[*] The Raven's Helmet can be found in the Mountain Cave after defeating the Lord of the Misty Lake
[/list] 

[u][b]Control Optimization[/b][/u] 

[list]
[*] D-pad can be used to select the number of items to sell in the store. 
[*] In the option menu, you can now select either D-Pad or Analogue Movement
[/list] 

[u][b]Mission Fixes[/b][/u] 

[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect walking animation when talking to bridge guard 
[*] Doctor now shows in the correct location after the meeting in the Town Hall 
[*] Shabbir won't disappear after talking with the Gram 
[*] Guard Storage room will be closed after the investigation 
[*] Maye Hall believers’ dialogue fixed 
[*] Clarified the mission description for "Eliminate Skeletons."
[/list]  

[u][b]Item Issues [/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Tara will now drop their weapon
[/list] 

[u][b]Balance Adjustment [/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Optimized following monster stats: Spike Wolf, Crawling Miner, Creeping Skull, Young Poison Toad 
[*] Reduced stamina costs of dual blade skills:  Crescent Spin and Full Moon Spin 
[*] Owl Claymore: increased attack damage by 15% and -30 stamina cost 
[*] Golden Hammer: +40 stamina cost 
[*] Increased the stamina cost of air dash 
[*] Reduce the Fallen Eyeball's cooldown
[/list] 


[u][b]Mini Map Issues [/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed Secret Trail’s save point not matching map pin location 
[/list]

[u][b]Level Issues[/b][/u] 

[list]
[*] Removed hittable cages in first chapter’s Catacomb and Miner’s Path 
[*] Decreased the height of the first stone wall at game opening, you can now jump with normal jump 
[*] On the lower left side of The Frozen Realm, the wind-blown cube will no longer cause a dead end 
[*] Players can now break a barrier from the other side of the Limestone Way to the Mine 
[*] Catacombs: Increased one-way destroyable obstacles
[/list] 

[u][b]Added breakable boxes to Spider Lair[/b][/u] 

[list]
[*] In the Upper Underground Hall, obstacles to secret passages have been removed
[/list] 

[b][u]Map Through Issues [/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Map fall through in Miner's Dining Room fixed 
[*] Fixed the stock issue of the breakable cube in the Middle Underground Hall 
[*] Now players can’t jump out of the map from right corner of the Wasted Town 
[*] Sealed all opened areas, players can no longer air dash off the map 
[/list]
 

[b][u]Effects Issues [/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Adjusted the effect size of the mechanical bow when using Elemental Enchantments 
[*] Adjusted the effective position of the Evading Slash skill 
[*] Entrance to the ship, the Mary Rose, has a hint to help guide the player  
[*] Fixed bug where certain effects are too bright. 
[/list]

notes.title: Updates Going Forward
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Vigilants![/h3]
[b]First, we want to thank you for all your support during the launch of Vigil: The Longest Night. It’s been an incredible experience for Glass Heart Games and our publisher, Another Indie! [/b]

We’ve received encouragement and support from around the globe, but we have also received many bug reports and players facing issues, especially on Nintendo Switch. We have spent the weekend talking with players and the community and are working to fix these issues as quickly as possible. This was our first game, so we are learning a lot and thanks for bearing with us! We are now going to go into more detail on specific issues: 


Issues including Placebo quest’s achievement not triggering, items not working correctly, unclear quest guidance, controller issues, and certain skills being too hard to activate will be fixed in the next update. The game’s technical structure means that certain modifications sometimes create other issues, meaning that both our internal and our Publishers QA team need to do a thorough test before the game goes live.  

 
On another note, we’ve discovered that some of our English text hasn’t uploaded correctly, meaning that some item descriptions are unpolished (we are not English speakers), we are going to upload fixes ASAP.  


We will keep you updated here and on Steam as we go forward. 

Finally, we must thank all you guys again, Glass Heart Games will keep polishing “Vigil: The Longest Night and we can’t wait to share more news with you in the future.

notes.title: 💉Introducing the Brood Mother
notes.content:
[h3]For those of you who played our Demo during the Steam Game Festival, you are probably intimately aware with the tragic tale of the Brood Mother. 
A tragedy of epic proportions where love, deception, and science mingled to corrupt and create this frenzied, beast. I won’t spoil the story behind the Brood Mother but suffice to say, it isn’t for the faint of heart. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34379227/5448f29f861a99529654590f00eaf3747d061a95.jpg[/img]

The design for the Brood Mother, as with most of our creations, came from the brilliant (possibly deranged) mind of our lead artist and Co-Founder Lin Li/Kevin who wanted to create something deeply disturbing for the game’s first major boss.

[i]“Brood Mother is a real nightmare, I wanted to make something that was immediately shocking, but which fit into the story and the world.”[/i] Along with Co-Founder Joyce Chen, they brainstormed a truly appalling creature made up of distended human body parts along with an insectile abdomen. She has malformed insectile wings, dozens of eyes, and a scream of inhuman fury and pain. She’s an absolute nightmare. Originally, she was supposed to be a fusion of moth and human, but after experimentation, Lin Li decided to use the common fly for his beastly creation, here’s an early image of the moth version for comparison.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34379227/9abd372af372b1e3377e9013912e23e0df21553a.jpg[/img]

But perhaps the most gruesome thing isn’t the Brood Mother, it’s her children. You read that right, her CHILDREN! Throughout the fight the Brood Mother will give birth to half human, half larvae children that will quick overwhelm you unless they are dealt with. As you can imagine, the effect is completely horrifying! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tuSuJs2.gif[/img]

Horror is always based in reality and Brood Mother’s ability to give birth makes one question other elements of her backstory as well as the nature of pregnancy and motherhood in a heavily religious, medieval society. “[i]We wanted the Brood Mother to be terrifying on every level. The more you think about it, the worse it gets” [/i]Lin Li told me!

We will have more information for you soon!

Yours,

Glassheart and Another Indie.

[h1][b]The tree of life, 🌳Yggdrasill🌳 has opened the doors to the Neverinth once more and summoned another fearless heroine to its halls. [/b][/h1]
She too faces the task of returning the universe to balance and restoring Valhalla to its former glory. 
Along with her trusted katana, she brings a unique set of abilities adding a touch of elegance and poise to Neverinth’s brutal combat. 
In addition, two new weapons (Freeze Bomb and Energy Mead) and three more jewels will be available in her path to the sacred halls reconquest.

[h1]Check out all the new updates![/h1]

[*]Added：New character – Proud Aspirant 
[*]Added：New weapon Type – Katana 
[*]Added：New skill for the Cultist Mentor boss 
[*]Added：2 New Items 
[*]Added：3 New Jewelry 
[*]Added：1 New Grace

[*]Bug fix：Enemies stop sometimes after we hit them 
[*] Character control improvements 
[/olist] 
[h1][h1]Adjustment of Totem Power[/h1] 
[/h1]
[list] 
[*]Garm Totem：Attack stamina consumption -70% -> -50%、Life Debt restoration with attack +35% -> +25% 
[/list] 
[h1][h1]Adjustment of Jewelry ability [/h1] 
[/h1]
[list] 
[*]Power of Will：When consuming stamina, increase damage % based on current stamina divided by 12 -> 10. 
[*]Earring of Exertion：Damage increases by 1% for every 5 -> 3 stamina points consumed 
[*]Frostbitten Necklace：Shield +180 -> +120. Increases damage taken by 30% -> 35% but freezes the nearby attacker. 
[*]Earring of Adrenaline：Shield +150 -> +70. Physical defense +2 -> +10 
[*]Earring of Proficiency：Shield +400 -> +250  
[*]Earring of Exchange：Shield +280 -> +200. When shielded, every 500 -> 300 Essence possessed by the character will increase damage by 1% 
[*]Alchemist's Ring：Shield +200 -> +150 
[/list]
